kmu.compatibility_lost_map_cursor: Sector map widgets won't respond directly to the cursor this session - no star system highlight and tooltip. The Map sidebar will still react to the cursor.
kmu.compatibility_unaffected_map_cursor: On everything else, including your save.
kmu.compatibility_lost_lunalib_settings: KMU won't react to its settings being changed this session. A change may not take effect until you restart the game.
kmu.compatibility_unaffected_lunalib_setting: On the settings themselves, which are still saved, on any other mod's settings, and on your save.
kmu.compatibility_lost_map_view: Map layers and the Map sidebar may not show on the sector map or on the intel screen's map this session.
kmu.compatibility_unaffected_map_view: On the maps themselves, and on your save.
kmu.compatibility_lost_filter_row_toggle: The Map Layers tick box may be missing from the map's filter row, or not show its key, this session. Map layers stay shown on a map without it.
kmu.compatibility_unaffected_filter_row_togg: On the rest of the filter row, and on your save.
kmu.compatibility_lost_arrange_dialog: The dialog for arranging map layers won't open this session.
kmu.compatibility_unaffected_arrange_dialog: On the layers themselves, which keep their last arrangement, and on your save.
kmu.compatibility_lost_screen_covers: The Map sidebar and hover box may stay drawn over the game's own dialogs and the codex this session.
kmu.compatibility_unaffected_screen_covers: On those dialogs and the codex themselves, and on your save.
kmu.compatibility_lost_map_tooltips: The game's own map tooltip may show beside the map layers' hover box, or under the Map sidebar, this session.
kmu.compatibility_unaffected_map_tooltips: On what either tooltip says, and on your save.
kmu.compatibility_lost_starscape_reseat: In Starscape mode, the part of the map layers meant to stay above the map's nebulae may be drawn under them this session.
kmu.compatibility_unaffected_starscape_resea: On the map with Starscape mode off, and on your save.
kmu.compatibility_lost_starscape_terrain: Map layers won't be drawn on the sector map in Starscape mode this session.
kmu.compatibility_unaffected_starscape_terra: On the map with Starscape mode off, and on your save.
kmu.compatibility_lost_map_layer: The %s map layer is switched off until you next load a save, or switch the map layers off and back on.
kmu.compatibility_unaffected_map_layer: On the other map layers, the map itself, and your save.
